verdict: MIXED — not ready for live send

items.name: OAuth
items.why: yoni122222@gmail.com connected on oren-car-claims. Token in claims_gmail_connection, no GRANT to anon/authenticated. Status payload has no refresh_token/secret. Revoke is super_admin only.

items.name: קריאת Gmail
items.why: list_messages + read_message against the live mailbox. format=metadata for list. mailboxMutated=false. From/subject/date/ids returned.

items.name: ייבוא מייל
items.why: Sender, subject, sent_at, message/thread IDs saved. Body stored as CRLF only (body_len=2, snippet empty). HTML body was not imported.

items.name: ייבוא כל המצורפים בפעולה אחת
items.why: One-action loop works (batches of 12 until done) but MAX_ATTACH=80 silently dropped 78 of 158 files with no user warning.

items.name: הרבה תמונות / קבצים
items.why: 80 JPEG files (4.8MB) imported in one worker action into DAL-QA-GMAIL-001.

items.name: גלריית תמונות
items.why: DB grouping is correct (1 gmail_message_id → 80 files). Live /claims UI in this session showed 0 claims so the gallery screen was not exercised visually.

items.name: שיוך לתביעה
items.why: All 80 docs on DAL-QA-GMAIL-001 only. Cross-claim count for that message id = 0. imported_by_name + created_at recorded. Worker without assignment cannot import.

items.name: Message ID
items.why: Saved on claims_records, claims_gmail_imports, claims_documents, claims_history.

items.name: Thread ID
items.why: Saved on the same rows as Message ID.

items.name: מסמכים
items.why: list_docs returned 80 files. signed_url issued (120s). Public object URL returned 400. Bucket is private. Per-file send picker is a separate FAIL (item 11).

items.name: בחירת מצורפים
items.why: No UI/API to pick one file, many files, photos, or surveyor PDF. Follow-up is only none|received (all files). Draft has no attachments.

items.name: סיכום והיסטוריה
items.why: exportClaimSummary dumps claims_history (internal worker actions) into the text intended for external use. No allowlist that strips internal notes.

items.name: טיוטה
items.why: Draft WAS created in the connected Gmail (draftId returned, sent=false). Missing CC, missing attachments, missing claim-file picker. Incomplete vs the requested draft QA.

items.name: חברת ביטוח
items.why: Mail modal prefills claim fields and can log/draft. No attachment picker, no send-type for insurer vs other, no size check. Live send blocked (correct).

items.name: טיפול משפטי
items.why: Legal tab + legal_transfer template exist and were filled. No preview that lets the user select summary/history/surveyor/photos/insurance/third-party docs. Not sent.

items.name: Follow-up חד-פעמי
items.why: Upsert, edit-before-due, Dry Run dispatch, status completed/dry_run_sent, preview to/subject/body, comm_log + history. realEmailSend=false.

items.name: Follow-up חוזר
items.why: email_repeat created next pending job ~7 days later; reminder stayed scheduled.

items.name: scheduler אמיתי ב-Dry Run
items.why: pg_cron job claims-mail-dispatch-staging (*/5). Unassisted fire after 29742ms. Preview realEmailSend=false, gmailTouched=false. One job processed.

items.name: ביטול
items.why: claims_cancel_mail_followup → reminder cancelled, pending jobs cancelled, not dispatched.

items.name: עצור מעקב
items.why: UI עצור מעקב = cancel. Also stop_at on a 1-day repeat completed with no further pending job.

items.name: כפילות
items.why: UNIQUE (reminder_id, planned_at) blocked a second pending job. inserted=0.

items.name: Retry
items.why: No retry RPC/UI. Failed jobs stay failed. Re-dispatch does not pick them (so no double send), but the owner cannot retry.

items.name: תיק סגור
items.why: Upsert rejected closed_claim. Dispatch of a pending job on a closed claim failed with fail_reason=closed_claim. No mail sent.

items.name: כתובת שגויה
items.why: Upsert rejected invalid_to. Dispatch fail_reason=invalid_to on a planted bad-to job.

items.name: קבצים גדולים
items.why: No outgoing size preview. Import silently skips oversize / over-cap files. 158→80 with no warning. Cannot choose a subset.

items.name: הרשאות עובד
items.why: Non-admin with claims_access, not assigned: list_messages 403 forbidden_claim, follow-up RPC forbidden, cannot see the QA claim, cannot revoke OAuth, no token in payloads.

items.name: RLS/API direct access
items.why: anon and worker cannot SELECT claims_gmail_connection (permission denied). anon cannot read claims. Edge with anon JWT → 403 user session required.

items.name: תיעוד History/Comm Log
items.why: Used existing claims_history and claims_comm_log only. Import, draft, follow-up upsert/edit/cancel, dry-run send, closed/invalid failures recorded.

items.name: לא נשלח מייל חיצוני אמיתי
items.why: send action 403 live_send_not_approved. Drafts only. Follow-up Dry Run. MAIL_DISPATCH_MODE restored to dry_run after a live-block probe. No insurer/lawyer/customer live send.

pendingLiveSendQa: Follow-up does not call Gmail API in dry_run (gmailTouched=false). Architecture to live Gmail send is not tested. Do not flip MAIL_DISPATCH_MODE to live without owner approval and an approved test mailbox.
nextRequiresOwner: Approved test recipient before any live send
Fix silent 80-file cap / HTML body import / attachment picker / summary leak / retry if those are required before live
